name: Wheel of Elements
body:
Price 34,324 gp; Slot none; CL 11th; Weight 10 lbs.; Aura moderate evocation

DESCRIPTION

This wheel of elements is an intricate starknife, each of its four blades embedded with different gemstones representing the four elements. It functions as a +1 cycling starknife that gains an additional property depending on which element of the cycling property is active, as follows:

Corrosive: The weapon is also neutralizing.
Flaming: The weapon is also thawing.
Frost: The weapon is also quenching.
Shock: The weapon is also grounding.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 17,824 gp; Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells elemental touch
